governance.canonical_kind: one historical entity per official biography/event/organization/region page
governance.claims_provenance_rule: Every major contested claim must reference S/C original evidence or a directly linked, qualified historical source; numeric estimates specify definition, location, and date.
governance.relationship_rule: Only assert explicit typed relationships (participated_in, led, member_of, located_in, precedes, part_of, cites), not keyword matches.

known_limitations: Imported legacy articles remain distinguishable from editorially reviewed articles.
Historical completeness and archival verification are not implied by a finished website.
